description: This Java source file defines a final class RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl that implements a builder pattern for creating responses related to retrieving attribute data in a 'live' command context as part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains methods to generate successful responses and error responses, utilizing inner classes and external command and response classes.
